name: Prairie milkweed
desc: Prairie milkweed (Asclepias oenotheroides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias oenotheroides, commonly known as zizotes milkweed or sidecluster milkweed, is a plant in the dogbane family. It grows in Central America, Mexico, and several US states.
